INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

3. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.

4. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.

5. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.

6. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.

7. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.

8. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Robotics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Graphic Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Audial- Visual Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
